subject: general
question:
Choose the option which is similar in meaning to the underlined word.

It's __incredible__ to see him in such good health after the accident.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Unimaginable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"incredible"** means something that is extraordinary, amazing, or difficult to believe. (अविश्वसनीय)
 
 
• **Example:** The view from the mountaintop was incredible—it felt like a dream.
 
 
• **"Unimaginable"** refers to something that cannot be comprehended or envisioned due to its extraordinary nature. (अकल्पनीय)
 
 
• **Example:** The destruction caused by the earthquake was unimaginable.
 
 
• Hence, the word "unimaginable" is similar in meaning to "incredible."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Unimaginable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unremarkable** (असाधारण नहीं): Refers to something that is ordinary or not worth noticing.
 
 
• **Example:** The movie was unremarkable and failed to leave an impression.
 
 
• **Apparent** (स्पष्ट): Refers to something that is clearly visible or understood.
 
 
• **Example:** It became apparent that he was not interested in the conversation.
 
 
• **Unacceptable** (अस्वीकार्य): Refers to something that cannot be tolerated or approved.
 
 
• **Example:** The rude behavior of the customer was completely unacceptable.

The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Teetotaler**.
